labelDescriptions.background: Everything that is not one of the five organ channels.
labelDescriptions.liver: Parenchyma including lesions (LiTS labels 1 and 2 merged).
labelDescriptions.kidney: Supervised only when KiTS19 is registered.
labelDescriptions.cervix: Supervised only by a volumetric dataset with cervix masks.

cases.title: Synthetic brain MRI with enhancing lesion
cases.label: PH-BRAIN-01/label.png
cases.note: Lesion, oedema and necrotic core are warped ellipsoids inside folded cortex. Only the brain channel is supervised, as in BraTS.

cases.title: Synthetic abdominal CT, liver with one lesion
cases.label: PH-ABDOMEN-01/label.png
cases.note: Kidneys and spleen are present in the anatomy but this corpus annotates only the liver, so their channels are unsupervised for this case.

cases.title: Synthetic pelvic CT with visible cervix
cases.label: PH-PELVIS-01/label.png
cases.note: The cervix is drawn in the anatomy, but no registered corpus supervises the cervix channel, so the server suppresses it.
